topics.statusLabel: UTOL Permitted AI Use Setting Required
topics.summary: On UTOL (UTokyo Online Learning), starting September 29, 2026, setting 'Permitted AI Use' is mandatory for all assignment creation. Course instructors must designate one of six standardized labels (T0 No AI Use; T1 questions/research only; T2 discussion/idea-bouncing; T3 feedback; T4 drafting; T5 creative use) or select 'Other' to provide specific written boundaries. Students must strictly adhere to the designated label for each assignment. Use only within the assignment’s stated permitted range; the reviewed guidance leaves course decisions to instructors.
topics.scope: All assignments, homework, and coursework submitted via UTOL across undergraduate and graduate divisions
actions: Check the UTOL assignment Permitted AI Use label (T0–T5 or Other) or course syllabus before using any generative AI tool.

topics.title: Research & Publication Ethics
topics.summary: Under Rule No. 79 (東京大学科学研究行動規範委員会規則), formal scientific research misconduct investigations establish procedural timelines qualified in principle (原則として): the preliminary inquiry results must be reported to the Committee Chair in principle within 30 days of receiving an allegation (Art. 8(5)); the Investigation Committee commences formal investigation in principle within 30 days of the decision to investigate (Art. 9(2)); the Committee makes its adjudication determination in principle within 150 days of starting formal investigation (Art. 11(1)); respondent defense opportunity is granted in principle within 14 days of receiving draft determination notification (Art. 11(7)); and a respondent against whom misconduct was determined may file an objection/appeal to the Committee Chair in principle within 30 days of receiving the determination notice under Art. 11(11) (Art. 12(1)). The Code of Conduct for Research mandates transparent scientific basis and prohibits fabrication, falsification, and plagiarism. These clocks apply exclusively to scientific research misconduct proceedings and do not govern undergraduate or generic coursework discipline.
topics.scope: Scientific research activities and formal research misconduct investigations under Rule No. 79 across all institutes and research divisions (all clocks qualified in principle)
actions: Adhere to the Code of Conduct for Research; never commit fabrication, falsification, or plagiarism with AI tools.
Understand that allegations of scientific research misconduct are investigated under Rule No. 79 with in-principle procedural timelines.

title.en: The University of Tokyo AI Policy
title.zh: 东京大学人工智能政策指南

scope.en: UTOL LMS mandatory assignment Permitted AI Use setting (effective Sept. 29, 2026), Taura EVP 6-level taxonomy (T0–T5 / Other), instructor coursework discretion, disclosure recommendations, campus-wide Copilot and Gemini commercial data protection, and research misconduct procedure under Rule No. 79 (qualified in principle).
scope.zh: 涵盖 UTOL 教学管理系统作业必填「AI利用范围」设定（2026 年 9 月 29 日起生效）、田浦理事·副学长六级分类体系（T0–T5 及 Other）、教师平时作业裁量权、披露推荐规范、全校 Copilot 与 Gemini 商用数据保护，以及基于第 79 号规则的科学研究不端行为调查程序（设立原则时限）。

do.en: Check the UTOL assignment Permitted AI Use label (T0–T5 or Other) or course syllabus before using any generative AI tool.
do.zh: 使用任何生成式 AI 前，务必查阅 UTOL 作业页面上标注的「AI利用范围」标签（T0–T5 或 Other）或课程大纲说明。

do.en: Follow the instructor’s disclosure instructions; central guidance recommends asking students to name the AI tool used.
do.zh: 遵循教师的披露要求；中央指南建议教师要求学生注明使用的 AI 工具名称。

do.en: Use the institutional account specified for each service and check its data safeguards; no-training protection does not prove no retention.
do.zh: 使用各服务指定的机构账号并核对数据保护条件；不用于训练并不等于不留存。

dont.en: Never input personal information, confidential data, or unpublished research into AI tools; faculty must basically not input examination questions into language generation AI in unchanged form.
dont.zh: 切勿将个人信息、机密资料或未发表研究成果输入 AI 工具；教师原则上（基本的に）不得将考题以原样形式输入语言生成式 AI。

dont.en: Do not copy and paste AI-generated answers and submit them as your own work; unauthorized submission violates academic integrity.
dont.zh: 严禁将 AI 生成的解答全盘复制粘贴并作为原创作业提交；未授权提交构成学术不端。

dont.en: Do not assume institutional tool access (Copilot, Gemini, Zoom, Slack) grants permission to use AI in coursework or examinations.
dont.zh: 切勿将拥有校级 AI 工具访问权限（Copilot、Gemini、Zoom、Slack）误认为具备课程考核使用许可。
